f.t: They announced the album Please Stop Laughing, due from AWAL on 8 May, with a song whose narrator Tucker Elkins called an unreliable, indecisive, hypocritical idiot.
f.src: Ray Bull announce new album 'Please Stop Laughing' - The Needle Drop
f.q: arriving May 8 via AWAL ... an unreliable narrator who is being an indecisive, hypocritical idiot.
